[ISBK.1.6] **`query_with_value` (optional, ABI v2).** For the aggregations a
rule reads with a value — `DS_SERIES_AGG_COUNT_OF` and `DS_SERIES_AGG_CONTAINS`,
whose value is the one looked up, and `DS_SERIES_AGG_PERCENTILE`, whose value is
the percentile — all exact over the window. libds passes `k_param` as 0 on every
call: no aggregation in this edition takes a `k`. A read that no declared
backing with this hook can serve answers the aggregation's cold value
([LSER.19.8]) and stashes `DS_ERR_SERIES_NO_BACKING` for the pump to return
([NERR.6]).
